full_description: FocusTimer is a productivity app that utilizes the Pomodoro Technique to help you stay focused and avoid distractions. The technique involves working in concentrated 25-minute increments, followed by a 5-minute break. This cycle can be repeated to help you stay motivated and increase your overall productivity. With FocusTimer, you can customize the length of your work sessions and breaks, as well as set specific goals and tasks to help you stay on track. The app also includes features such as statistics tracking, reminders, and customizable notifications to help you make the most of your time. By using FocusTimer, you can improve your concentration, reduce procrastination, and achieve a better work-life balance.
